payload.explanation:
Violations stand at run end, so the run is non_conformant.

(1) The assembly collapsed at the last step. inverted_u_yellow stopped ~8 mm short of its seat. release then opened the RG2 to 104 mm inside the crowded slot, and the fingers wedged against the seated U-parts. The 0.1 m TCP retreat levered base1 with all parts up and over, and base1 landed ~0.40 m away in +x. u_orange (~0.10 m off, flipped) and inverted_u_yellow (34 mm / ~32 deg off) are outside tolerance. u_brown and line_green are marginally within tolerance relative to the displaced frames. The previously seated parts and base1 were all disturbed far beyond tolerance. This is robot-caused (obs-005; finding on place_inverted_u_yellow), and it cannot be corrected because base1 is never picked.

(2) Bystander hex_red was displaced 0.36 m during place_approach_u_orange while the arm was stationary ~0.3 m away. This was an external, non-robot cause (obs-002; finding on that step). It is uncorrected because bystanders may not be manipulated.

(3) An inconclusive finding on place_line_green: base1 was transiently lifted 5 mm during seating. base1 has no registry tolerance, so it is not judged to a threshold.

Each part met its tolerances at its own place step until the collapse: u_brown 2.2 mm/1.2 deg; u_orange 2.2 mm/0.7 deg; line_green 9.2 mm/3.0 deg. All grasp widths were within 0.02 m of grasp_width_m, all lifts exceeded 0.05 m, and the slip and clamp monitors never fired; peak finger effort was ~59 against limits of 100-250. The other bystanders (u_green, inverted_u_brown, hex_blue, base2) never moved.

Unwatched: base1/base2 disturbance has no registry tolerance, so it was observed only with agent-chosen look triggers.

Other observations: an unlisted red cube appeared mid-run and is still present (obs-001). A transient unidentified slab entered and left (obs-003, resolved).

Process note: place_approach_u_orange authored no target_offset, so I used the sibling U-part's 5 cm standoff to honour 'stop clear of contact'.
